title: R1/R2 no-letter-suffix districts (R1-1, R1-2, R2) - section 23-421(g) reference-plane elevation allowance
description: DRAFT extraction (needs_review) of ZR 23-421 paragraph (g) (City of Yes, Last Amended 2024-12-05), captured via the official print/PDF channel (M4-T012 binding capture-completeness requirement; see project-control/reports/M4-T012-source-capture.md): 'In R1 and R2 Districts without a letter suffix, for zoning lots that either (1) have a lot area of at least 9,500 square feet and lot width of at least 100 feet, or (2) have a slope, as measured from the street wall line level to the rear wall line level, of at least five percent to the horizontal; the reference plane for applying the regulations of this Section may be located up to five feet above the base plane.' This is an EXPLICIT CONDITIONAL, never a silent application or a silent omission (D-049-R003): the applicability trigger is the exact area/width/slope test the source states, and ALL THREE geometry inputs (lot_area_sqft, lot_width_ft, rear_wall_slope_percent) are REQUIRED - a caller missing even one of them (e.g. slope unmeasured) yields professional_review_required with NO value, even in the case where the OTHER two inputs alone would already have resolved the trigger. This is a deliberately CONSERVATIVE design choice disclosed here: the DSL's fail-closed missing-required-input handling is evaluated before applicability, so it cannot selectively ignore an input that happens to be redundant for a particular lot; encoding the OR as two independent competing rules to relax this was considered and rejected for this wave as unnecessary engine-adjacent complexity (no engine change is needed or permitted here; forbidden path). Eligibility is scoped to district symbols WITHOUT A LETTER SUFFIX per the source's own wording - R1-1, R1-2 (numerical suffixes, read by the owner as distinct from letter suffixes) and bare R2 are eligible; R1-2A, R2A, and R2X (letter suffixes) are EXCLUDED (owner's suffix reading, D-049, corroborated by docs/ARCHITECT_REVIEW_QUESTIONS.md section A1/A3). The output is a SEPARATE typed constraint (reference_plane_elevation_max_ft) describing WHERE the reference plane for the 25/35 ft envelope may sit - it does NOT change the 25 ft / 35 ft numeric caps themselves (those are computed by r1-r2-bare-pitched-height / r1-r2-suffix-variants-pitched-height). The full sloping-plane setback geometry this reference plane feeds into remains a typed A2 gap (D-045-R008), never computed here. NOT a Verified determination.

citations.quote: In R1 and R2 Districts without a letter suffix, for zoning lots that either: (1) have a lot area of at least 9,500 square feet and lot width of at least 100 feet; or (2) have a slope ... of at least five percent to the horizontal; the reference plane for applying the regulations of this Section may be located up to five feet above the base plane.

inputs.name: zoning_district
inputs.description: Residence district governing the lot. Applicability is EXACTLY the no-letter-suffix members section 23-421(g) itself names as eligible: R1-1, R1-2, and bare R2 (in_set). R1-2A, R2A, and R2X (letter-suffix variants) are deliberately NOT matched (visible not_applicable), per the owner's D-049 suffix reading. Bare 'R1' is also not matched: it is not among the districts the owner's verbatim reading of (g) or docs/ARCHITECT_REVIEW_QUESTIONS.md lists as eligible.

inputs.name: building_type
inputs.description: Building type. REQUIRED and FAIL-CLOSED, matching the pitched-envelope rules this reference plane feeds: paragraph (g) is part of section 23-421, which applies only to single- or two-family detached / semi-detached / zero-lot-line forms. No canonical property_profile field exposes this.

inputs.name: lot_area_sqft
inputs.description: Zoning-lot area in square feet; must be strictly positive. REQUIRED (see description: all three geometry inputs are required by design, even though area+width alone can resolve the trigger). A zero/negative/non-finite value is rejected fail-closed.

inputs.name: lot_width_ft
inputs.description: Zoning-lot width in feet; must be strictly positive. REQUIRED (see description).

inputs.name: rear_wall_slope_percent
inputs.description: Lot slope, measured from the street-wall-line level to the rear-wall-line level, expressed as a percent. REQUIRED (see description: all three geometry inputs are required by design, even though slope alone can resolve the trigger).

outputs.name: reference_plane_elevation_max_ft
outputs.description: Maximum elevation (ft) above the base plane at which the section 23-421 reference plane may be located, per paragraph (g), when the district/building-type/geometry trigger is met. Separate typed constraint; does NOT change the 25 ft / 35 ft envelope caps and is not a buildable-envelope result.

parameters.name: reference_plane_offset_ft
parameters.note: Section 23-421(g): the reference plane 'may be located up to five feet above the base plane'. Candidate value pending raw-HTML verification and G6 approval.

steps.note: Maximum reference-plane elevation above the base plane per section 23-421(g).

exceptions.description: This reference-plane elevation feeds into the section 23-421 sloping-plane envelope construction (paragraphs (a)-(f)), which is A2 sloping-plane geometry, not computed by this rule (D-045-R008). The 25 ft perimeter-wall / 35 ft ridge caps this reference plane is measured from are computed by the separate rule r1-r2-bare-pitched-height (for bare R2) or r1-r2-suffix-variants-pitched-height (for R1-1/R1-2, which that rule reaches via ZR 11-25 suffix inheritance even though this reference-plane rule cites section 23-421(g) directly and expressly for R1-1/R1-2).

Overlay, special-district, historic-district, large-site, and transportation-infrastructure modifiers (sections 23-44, 23-425, 23-426(a), 23-443(b), 119-212, 113-523) are modeled on the companion envelope rules (r1-r2-bare-pitched-height), not on this reference-plane rule; their potential interaction with paragraph (g)'s allowance is not evaluated here and is disclosed as a documented limitation rather than silently assumed absent.

uncertainty_policy.note: An uncertain, split, sliver, or invalid M2-T013 geometric district assignment is never collapsed into a single definitive district: coverage downgrades to professional_review_required (or data_conflict).

limitations: Draft extraction pending raw-HTML source verification and G6 qualified-human legal approval; not a Verified determination.

CONSERVATIVE-BY-DESIGN: all three geometry inputs (area, width, slope) are REQUIRED, so a lot known to satisfy the trigger via ONE path (e.g. area+width) but missing the OTHER path's input (slope) still fails closed to professional_review_required rather than emitting a value from the one known-satisfied path. This never produces a wrong answer, but it is more conservative than the source strictly requires; relaxing it would need either a second competing rule (risking a same-family output conflict against this rule) or an engine change (forbidden path) - out of scope for this wave and disclosed rather than silently accepted.
Eligibility is scoped to R1-1, R1-2, and bare R2 (no-letter-suffix, per the owner's D-049 suffix reading); R1-2A, R2A, R2X, and bare R1 are NOT eligible under this rule.
The output changes only the REFERENCE PLANE the pitched envelope is measured from; it does not modify the 25 ft / 35 ft numeric caps.
The full sloping-plane setback geometry (23-421 paragraphs a-f) that this reference plane feeds into remains an A2 gap (D-045-R008) and is not computed here.
Site-specific modifiers (overlay, special district, historic district, large site, transportation infrastructure) are not modeled on this rule; see the companion envelope rules.
